'''Helmut Hermann W. Hofer''' (born February 28, 1956)<ref>{{cite web|title=Curriculum Vitae Prof. Dr. Helmut Hofer|website=Leopoldina Nationale Akademie der Wissenschaften|url=https://www.leopoldina.org/fileadmin/redaktion/Mitglieder/CV_Hofer_Helmut_D.pdf}}</ref> is a German-American mathematician, one of the founders of the area of [[symplectic topology]].<ref name=ias>{{cite web|url=http://www.ias.edu/news/press-releases/1216821088|title=IAS press release|publisher=IAS|access-date=February 29, 2012|archive-date=August 5, 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160805140618/https://www.ias.edu/news/press-releases/1216821088|url-status=dead}}</ref>

He is a member of the [[National Academy of Sciences]],<ref>{{cite web|publisher=NYU|title=2 NYU faculty elected to National Academy of Sciences|url=http://www.eurekalert.org/pub_releases/2008-04/nyu-tnf042908.php}}</ref> and the recipient of the 1999 [[Ostrowski Prize]]<ref>{{cite journal|mr=1776106|title=Beilinson and Hofer share Ostrowski Prize|journal=Notices Amer. Math. Soc.|volume=47|year=2000|issue=8|page=885|url=https://www.ams.org/notices/200008/comm-ostrowski.pdf}}</ref>
and the 2013 [[Heinz Hopf Prize]]. Since 2009, he has been a faculty member at the [[Institute for Advanced Study]] in Princeton, New Jersey.<ref name=ias/> He currently works on [[symplectic geometry]], [[dynamical systems]], and [[partial differential equations]]. His contributions to the field include Hofer geometry. Hofer was elected to the [[American Academy of Arts and Sciences]] in 2020.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.amacad.org/new-members-2020|title=New Members|website=American Academy of Arts & Sciences|language=en|access-date=April 23, 2020}}</ref>

He was an invited speaker at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] (ICM) in 1990 in Kyoto<ref>{{cite book|author=Hofer, Helmut|chapter=Symplectic invariants|title=Proceedings of the International Congress of Mathematicians (1990, Kyoto)|volume=1|pages=521–528|year=1991}}</ref> and a plenary speaker at the ICM in 1998 in Berlin.<ref>{{cite book|author=Hofer, Helmut H. W.|chapter=Dynamics, topology, and holomorphic curves|title=Doc. Math. (Bielefeld) Extra Vol. ICM Berlin, 1998, vol. I|year=1998|pages=255–280|chapter-url=https://www.elibm.org/ft/10011724000}}</ref>

He is currently an editor of ''[[Annals of Mathematics]]''.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Editorial Board {{!}} Annals of Mathematics |url=https://annals.math.princeton.edu/board |access-date=March 25, 2024 |language=en-US}}</ref>
